paragraphs: In a new global retirement index, Uruguay ranked as the best place in the world to retire abroad, and took the top spot from Portugal.

The study compared 46 retirement and passive-income programs across several areas, including quality of life, travel freedom, citizenship routes, taxation, and costs. While Uruguay leads overall due to balanced scores, Europe remains the most represented region. Six spots are in the top ten, including Spain, Portugal, Latvia, Andorra, Italy, and Greece.

European nations excel in living standards, strong passports, and safety, but often lose points for higher taxes and complex rules. For example, Spain ranks high for quality of life but lowest for taxes, while Portugal slipped to fifth place after increasing its citizenship requirement to ten years. Meanwhile, other regions offer different perks, such as tax benefits in Mauritius and the Middle East, or great affordability and fast citizenship across the Americas.

paragraphs: A new study names Uruguay as the best country in the world for retirement, while Portugal drops to fifth place.

The index looked at 46 retirement programs around the world. It checked quality of life, travel freedom, taxes, and costs. Even though Uruguay is number one, Europe still has six countries in the top ten, including Spain, Greece, and Italy. European countries are great for high living standards and safe travel, but they often have high taxes. For example, Spain is wonderful for living but has the highest taxes on the list. Portugal is still popular and affordable, but now requires ten years to get citizenship.
Other parts of the world, like the Americas and Mauritius, are attractive because they offer lower taxes and cheaper living costs.

paragraphs: A new report says that Uruguay is now the best place in the world to retire. Last year, Portugal is number one, but now it is fifth.

The report looks at many countries to find the best countries for older people. Europe still has six countries in the top ten list, including Spain, Italy, and Greece. European places are very nice, safe, and clean, but they often have high taxes.
Other parts of the world, like South America, have lower costs and easier rules. People who want to move abroad can choose what they like most, like good weather, low taxes, or easy travel.
